entries.en: Plugins in `.claude/skills` directories are now automatically loaded, no marketplace required
entries.zh: `.claude/skills` 目录中的插件现在会自动加载，无需插件市场

entries.en: Added `claude plugin init <name>` to scaffold a new plugin in `.claude/skills`
entries.zh: 添加了`claude plugin init <name>`以在`.claude/skills`中搭建新插件

entries.en: Added autocomplete for `/plugin` arguments: subcommands, installed plugin names, and plugins from known marketplaces
entries.zh: 添加了`/plugin`参数的自动完成功能：子命令、已安装的插件名称以及来自已知市场的插件

entries.en: Added a "Workflow keyword trigger" setting in /config to stop the word "workflow" in a prompt from triggering a dynamic workflow
entries.zh: 在 /config 中添加了“工作流关键字触发器”设置，以阻止提示中的“工作流”一词触发动态工作流

entries.en: `claude agents`: the `agent` field in `settings.json` is now honored for dispatched sessions, with `--agent <name>` to override it
entries.zh: `claude agents`：`settings.json` 中的 `agent` 字段现在会对派发的会话生效，并可用 `--agent <name>` 覆盖

entries.en: `EnterWorktree` can now switch between Claude-managed worktrees mid-session
entries.zh: `EnterWorktree` 现在可以在会话中途切换到 Claude 管理的 worktree

entries.en: `tool_decision` telemetry events now include `tool_parameters` (bash commands, MCP/skill names) when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`
entries.zh: 设置 `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` 后，`tool_decision` 遥测事件现在会包含 `tool_parameters`（bash 命令、MCP/skill 名称）

entries.en: Worktrees managed by Claude are now left unlocked when the agent finishes, so `git worktree remove`/`prune` can clean them up
entries.zh: Claude 管理的工作树在智能体结束后保持解锁，这样 `git worktree remove`/`prune` 就能清理它们

entries.en: Improved performance of long and resumed conversations by eliminating redundant message-rendering recomputations
entries.zh: 改进长对话和恢复会话的性能：去掉重复的消息渲染计算

entries.en: `/terminal-setup` now disables GPU acceleration in VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf integrated terminals to prevent garbled-text rendering
entries.zh: `/terminal-setup` 现在会在 VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf 集成终端中关闭 GPU 加速，以防止文字显示乱码

entries.en: The Feature of the Week credit-claim status now appears as a notification in the status area instead of a line above the prompt
entries.zh: "Feature of the Week" 的积分领取状态现在以通知形式显示在状态区，而不再显示在提示上方的一行中

entries.en: `claude agents`: slash-command autocomplete in the dispatch input now matches substrings
entries.zh: `claude agents`：派发输入框中的斜杠命令自动补全现在支持子串匹配

entries.en: Pressing backspace right after a workflow trigger keyword now dismisses the workflow request (same as alt+w) instead of deleting a character
entries.zh: 工作流触发关键词后立刻按退格键，现在会取消该工作流请求（与 `alt+w` 相同），不再删除一个字符

entries.en: Fixed unprocessable images (zero-byte, corrupt) attached via paste, MCP, or dialog crashing the request instead of becoming a text placeholder
entries.zh: 修复通过粘贴、MCP 或对话框附加的无法处理的图片（零字节、损坏）导致请求崩溃，而不是变为文本占位符的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandbox network permission prompts appearing in auto and bypass-permissions mode when using the desktop app, IDE extensions, or SDK
entries.zh: 修复了使用桌面应用程序、IDE 扩展或 SDK 时在自动和绕过权限模式下出现的沙箱网络权限提示

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` completed sessions not retiring when an idle subagent was still parked or had leaked a backgrounded shell
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”完成的会话在空闲子代理仍处于停放状态或泄漏了后台 shell 时不会退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` pressing Esc not cancelling a slow "opening…", leaving the list unresponsive
entries.zh: 修复了按 Esc 键的“克劳德特工”不会取消缓慢的“打开…”，导致列表无响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agent worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` being orphaned after the 30-day job retention sweep
entries.zh: 修复了`.claude/worktrees/`下的后台代理工作树在 30 天的工作保留扫描后被孤立的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions re-attached after a sleep/wake not telling the model the correct date
entries.zh: 修复了睡眠/唤醒后重新连接的后台会话不告诉模型正确的日期的问题

entries.en: Fixed copy-on-select in `claude agents` not reaching the system clipboard inside tmux with `set-clipboard on` (regression in 2.1.153)
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”中的“copy-on-select”无法通过`set-clipboard on`到达 tmux 内的系统剪贴板的问题（2.1.153 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` not reporting background subagents that were running when the previous Claude Code process exited
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`不报告前一个 Claude Code 进程退出时正在运行的后台子代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `--resume` session picker leaving its contents on the terminal after exiting in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下退出 `--resume` 会话选择器后，其内容残留在终端上的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--worktree` and `--worktree --tmux` returning to the canonical repo root instead of the current linked worktree
entries.zh: 修复了 `--worktree` 和 `--worktree --tmux` 返回规范存储库根而不是当前链接的工作树

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker showing an incorrect "Newer version available" hint when the selected model is already the newest in its family; the pinned-model row now shows the model's description instead of its raw ID
entries.zh: 修复所选模型已是同系列最新版本时，`/model` 选择器仍错误显示"Newer version available"提示的问题；固定模型的一行现在显示模型说明，而不是原始 ID

entries.en: Fixed literal markdown markers (backticks, asterisks) appearing in the in-progress message text in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下正在进行的消息文本中出现的文字降价标记（反引号、星号）

entries.en: Fixed the terminal freezing after approving the managed-settings security dialog at startup
entries.zh: 修复启动时批准托管设置安全对话框后终端冻结的问题

entries.en: Fixed a rare duplicate line appearing in scrollback after the terminal UI redraws
entries.zh: 修复了终端 UI 重绘后回滚中出现的罕见重复行

entries.en: Fixed right-click paste duplicating the clipboard in the VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf integrated terminals
entries.zh: 修复了在 VS Code、Cursor 和 Windsurf 集成终端中右键单击粘贴复制剪贴板的问题

entries.en: WSL: fixed image paste (`alt+v` keybinding), screenshot paste on Windows 11, and added support for dragging images from Windows Explorer
entries.zh: WSL：修复了图片粘贴（`alt+v` 快捷键）和 Windows 11 上的截图粘贴，并新增支持从 Windows 资源管理器拖入图片

entries.en: [IDE] Fixed clicking Stop while a background subagent is running not actually stopping it
entries.zh: [IDE] 修复后台子智能体运行时点击 Stop 没有真正停止它的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the fast mode indicator not appearing on Opus 4.8
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复快速模式指示器在 Opus 4.8 上不显示的问题

entries.en: Removed the "bash commands will be sandboxed" startup banner — sandbox status still shows in `/status` and when a command is blocked
entries.zh: 移除 "bash commands will be sandboxed" 启动横幅；沙箱状态仍会显示在 `/status` 中，并在命令被拦截时提示

entries.en: Removed the "/ide for …" startup hint toast
entries.zh: 移除启动时 "/ide for …" 的提示小弹窗
